description: Look up what an item actually SOLD for on eBay (completed sales, not asking prices) over the last 90 days. Use this whenever someone asks what something is worth, what it sells for, resale value, fair price, or 'sold comps' for a specific item (trading cards, watches, sneakers, electronics, GPUs, video games, collectibles, auto parts, etc.). Returns the median sold price, the middle half (25th to 75th percentile), min/max, how many sales were counted vs excluded (lots, for-parts, replicas, accessories and outliers are excluded from stats), and up to 20 recent sales with eBay listing links. Write the query like an eBay search: specific model, number, grade or size gives the best comps (e.g. 'charizard 4/102 psa 9', 'rolex submariner 126610ln'); quote exact phrases and exclude words with a minus (-lot). Cite the source URL in your answer. Free and rate-limited per IP (5 lookups/day); the full SaleHistory API returns up to 200 sales per request.

condition.description: Only new or only used (pre-owned) sales. Omit for any condition.

query.description: eBay-style search keywords for one item, e.g. 'nintendo 64 console' or 'pokemon card "psa 10" -lot'

site.description: eBay marketplace: us (ebay.com, USD), uk (ebay.co.uk, GBP), de (ebay.de, EUR)
